resources.string: The sync server refuses the plans
Sync files not written – storage full?
Open plan.onpath.earth on your computer, click “Connect phone” and scan the code.
If the browser opens instead of OnPath: tap “Open in OnPath” there.
Your plans and GPX tracks in the web planner too – encrypted.
No camera app found – open the camera yourself and scan the code.
On your computer open plan.onpath.earth → ‘Connect phone’ and scan the code
Check: %1$s – the browser shows the same six digits.
Connected. What you save in the browser comes to your phone – everything is kept there.
Plans stop syncing. They stay on this phone and in the browser.
Disconnected. Your plans stay on your phone.
Disconnected. Your plans stay on your phone – the browser couldn't be reached, disconnect it there too.
The connection was ended in the browser. Your plans stay on this phone.
Offline – your plans sync when the connection is back.
The sync server did not accept the plans (%1$s). Try again later.
The browser sync is full – delete some plans or tracks, then try again.
